candidates.change_summary: Removed the guard that prevents multiple guesses by deleting the require that checks guesses[msg.sender].block == 0, allowing subsequent calls to overwrite an existing guess and block value.
Changed the block assignment to use the current block number (block.number) instead of block.number + 1 so the stored block is the present block when lockInGuess returns.

Reordered assignments so the block number is set before the guess, changing the state visible immediately after the call (the stored guess may be observed as zero briefly if read between operations internally).

Inserted clearing of the guess before setting new values, which sets prior guess to zero and could change observed state after the call (the final stored guess still the same but intermediate state differs); ensures a visible write to guess occurs first.
Replace the comparison that checks if the guess matches the answer with an inverted comparison so the transfer happens when the guess does NOT match the answer.
Move the line that zeroes the stored block to after the conditional so the stored block is only cleared when the guess matches the answer (i.e., when transfer occurs).
Change the requirement that block.number be strictly greater than the stored block to allow equal block numbers (>=), letting settle proceed earlier.
Replace computation of answer using only the stored block number (no blockhash), making answer deterministic based on that uint converted to bytes32.
